newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech bank CSOB to cut prime rate, base rate steady.
newsitem.headline: Czech bank CSOB to cut prime rate, base rate steady.

text.p: Czech bank Ceskoslovenska Obchodni Banka a.s. on Tuesday said it would lower its prime lending rate by 10 basis points to 12.55 percent as of September 2, the Czech news agency CTK reported.
CTK added the bank was leaving its base lending rate unchanged at 11.75 percent.
Bank officials were not immediately available for comment. No reason for the change in interest rates was given.

CTK added that interest rates for credits of up to one year would fall to 12.8 percent (from 12.9 percent), up to two years to 13.05 percent (13.15 percent), and up to three years to 13.3 percent (13.4 percent).
Interest rates on the Prague money market have eased slightly recently, with one-year funds averaging 12.61 percent on the Prague Interbank Offered Rate (PRIBOR) on Tuesday.
The central bank discount rate currently stands at 10.5 percent.
